gold_sql: SELECT cgpa FROM students WHERE student_id = '24ENTC015'
SELECT c.title, e.attendance_pct FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c USING (course_code) WHERE e.student_id = '23CE001' AND e.status = 'ongoing' AND e.attendance_pct < 75
SELECT SUM(amount_due - amount_paid) FROM fee_ledger WHERE student_id = '23IT016' AND academic_year = '2026-27'
SELECT SUM(o.offers) FROM placement_offers_by_branch o JOIN placement_drives d USING (drive_id) WHERE d.academic_year = '2022-23' AND o.branch = 'IT'
SELECT company, package_lpa FROM placement_drives WHERE academic_year = '2025-26' AND package_lpa = (SELECT MAX(package_lpa) FROM placement_drives WHERE academic_year = '2025-26')
SELECT start_date, end_date FROM academic_calendar WHERE event LIKE 'End-semester examination%' AND 'TE' = ANY(string_to_array(applies_to, ','))
SELECT replace(event, ' (holiday)', ''), start_date FROM academic_calendar WHERE event ILIKE '%holiday%' AND start_date > DATE '2026-11-23' ORDER BY start_date LIMIT 1
SELECT d.closes_on FROM grant_deadlines d JOIN grants g USING (grant_id) WHERE g.grant_name = 'Women in Tech Research Grant'

WITH me AS ( SELECT s.*, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM enrollments e WHERE e.student_id = s.student_id AND e.status = 'ongoing' AND e.attendance_pct < 75) AS attendance_ok, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fee_ledger f WHERE f.student_id = s.student_id AND f.status = 'overdue') AS fees_ok FROM students s WHERE s.student_id = '23ENTC008') SELECT g.grant_name, d.closes_on FROM me, grants g JOIN grant_deadlines d USING (grant_id) WHERE DATE '2026-11-23' BETWEEN d.opens_on AND d.closes_on AND me.attendance_ok AND me.fees_ok AND me.active_backlogs = 0 AND me.year_of_study IN (3, 4) AND CASE g.grant_name WHEN 'Undergraduate Research Seed Grant' THEN me.cgpa >= 8.0 WHEN 'Women in Tech Research Grant' THEN me.gender = 'F' AND me.cgpa >= 7.5 WHEN 'Embedded and Wireless Research Grant' THEN me.branch = 'ENTC' AND me.cgpa >= 7.5 ELSE false END ORDER BY d.closes_on
SELECT fee_type, amount_due - amount_paid FROM fee_ledger WHERE student_id = '23ENTC005' AND status = 'overdue'
SELECT fee_type, amount_due - amount_paid FROM fee_ledger WHERE student_id = '25IT013' AND status = 'overdue' AND fee_type IN ('tuition_fee', 'development_fee')
SELECT c.title, e.attendance_pct FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c USING (course_code) WHERE e.student_id = '23CE003' AND e.status = 'ongoing' AND e.attendance_pct < 75

SELECT s.cgpa, e.ise_marks, d.closes_on FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id AND e.course_code = 'IT163' JOIN grant_deadlines d ON d.grant_id = 4 WHERE s.student_id = '24IT002'
SELECT s.cgpa, e.grade_letter FROM students s JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id AND e.course_code = 'CE128' WHERE s.student_id = '23CE020'
SELECT cgpa, active_backlogs FROM students WHERE student_id = '23CE004'

SELECT r.cgpa, r.branch_rank, c.title, e.attendance_pct FROM student_branch_rank r JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = r.student_id AND e.status = 'ongoing' AND e.attendance_pct < 75 JOIN courses c USING (course_code) WHERE r.student_id = '24ENTC003'
